title: Collaborative study observes ultra-low near-junction thermal resistance in GaN devices
titleZh: 合作研究在 GaN 器件中观测到极低的近结热阻
body: In a collaborative study on GaN devices, advanced thin-film epitaxial growth has enabled an ultra-low near-junction thermal resistance — an important step toward high-power-density gallium nitride radio-frequency transistors. The work has been published in Nature Communications, and a follow-up paper elucidating the underlying heat-conduction mechanism is forthcoming.
bodyZh: 在 GaN 器件合作研究中，先进的薄膜外延生长工艺实现了极低的近结热阻，是迈向高功率密度氮化镓射频晶体管的重要一步。该成果已发表于 Nature Communications，阐明其热传导机制的后续论文亦在整理发表之中。
